cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PY'
# Final sanity: run all examples and confirm exit codes and outputs parse as JSON.
import subprocess, json
for f in ["empty","ambiguity","bad-type"]:
    out=subprocess.run(["./run.sh"],stdin=open("/app/examples/%s.json"%f,"rb"),capture_output=True)
    assert out.returncode==0, (f,out.returncode,out.stderr)
    json.loads(out.stdout)
    print(f, out.stdout.decode())
# empty stdin
p=subprocess.run(["./run.sh"],input=b"",capture_output=True)
assert p.returncode==0 and json.loads(p.stdout)=={"error":"E_JSON"}
print("all good")
PY
